headline: 7 contracts catalogued on Solana; stake pool, token, and authority/management accounts identified

findings.text: Solana block explorer search via solanacompass.com identified JPool stake pool program at CtMyWsrUtAwXWiGr9WjHT5fC3p3fgV8cyGpLTo2LJzG1 with associated JSOL token and authority accounts
Protocol documentation site at docs.jpool.one references FAQ and deployment details, though direct fetch unavailable; solanacompass.com serves as canonical addresses source
No audit links recorded in protocol context; audit references mentioned in docs.jpool.one/additional-information/faq but fetch blocked
GitHub organization mfactory-lab located; contains spl-stake-pool repository and other infrastructure; jpool-pub contains public assets only
Single-chain protocol (Solana); all discovered addresses are on Solana mainnet
Stake pool is not a factory; delegates to 93 validators per current epoch but individual validator accounts are protocol-external entities
Seven addresses catalogued with roles: stake_pool, token, manager, staker, deposit_authority, withdraw_authority, validator_list_storage, fee_account, reserve_stake

rationale.verdict: Solana Compass page provides authoritative on-chain view of stake pool addresses and associated accounts; GitHub organization confirmed as development source; 7 core contracts catalogued across stake pool program, token mint, and authority/management accounts.

evidence.shows: JPool stake pool program address CtMyWsrUtAwXWiGr9WjHT5fC3p3fgV8cyGpLTo2LJzG1, JSOL token mint 7Q2afV64in6N6SeZsAAB81TJzwDoD6zpqmHkzi9Dcavn, and all associated authority and management account addresses
mfactory-lab organization owns spl-stake-pool and related Solana infrastructure repositories
jpool-pub is public assets repository for JPool; contains Apache-2.0 licensed materials
Search result from jpool.one and docs.jpool.one confirm JPool operates liquid staking on Solana with JSOL token, using spl-stake-pool foundation

unknowns: D2: docs.jpool.one deployment page fetch failed; no canonical deployed_contracts_doc verified
D3: audit_links empty in context and docs page inaccessible; audit status unknown
D4: spl-stake-pool repository not fetched; commit SHA for JPool-specific code unknown

protocol_metadata.about: <cite index="1-1,1-2">JPool is a Solana liquid staking platform allowing users to stake SOL and earn auto-compounding JSOL rewards with liquid, direct, or leveraged staking options.</cite> <cite index="17-1,17-2">JPool is a Solana staking pool implementation with low fees, advanced smart strategy, and is based on a secure smart contract maintained by the Solana Foundation.</cite>
